تجتلوا (form VIII)
# تَجْتَلُوا (tajtalū) /tad͡ʒ.ta.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَلَى (ijtalā)
# تُجْتَلَوْا (tujtalaw) /tud͡ʒ.ta.law/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَلَى (ijtalā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
